QuestInfo.name: [Epic Dungeon] The Vanished Celestials
QuestInfo.0:
Mitra possessed Seren in Cernium and confronted the Adversary. He awakened from his long slumber in the aftermath of the loss, and returned to High Mountain infuriated.

But there was no one waiting on High Mountain. It was only filled with the kin of the evil ancient god, Tynos. Mitra decided to find out what happened there.
